verdict.rationale: Tilled exposes a broad payments API (payment intents, disputes API, webhooks API, merchant onboarding, batch close) that mirrors many Dashboard actions, but several UI-only functions have no documented API equivalent — e.g. viewing payout speed and managing subscriptions/pricing templates are described only as Dashboard workflows, and no llms.txt or agent-oriented API index exists to confirm full parity. missing for 10: documented API endpoints for payout-speed viewing, subscription management, pricing-template creation equivalent to Dashboard UI, and an agent-discoverable API index confirming full UI/API parity.
